content.text: We are considering implementing a bonus program for our warehouse associates and I need to calculate the bonus amounts based on the actual productivity over the last eight weeks, guidelines are provided after the productivity reports. The bonus is paid based on the hours worked while completing tasks in each function. I need a concise report only without additional commentary, that I can review with my manager and that includes the following information in a table for each week: Employee number (do not include any names), total hours worked in a function, the total bonus earned, total hours worked/paid for the week (from the last page) and the percent of active hours. The percentage of active hours is the total hours of all functions/total hours for the week and then multiply 100 to ensure we get that percent. Sort the list by highest bonus to lowest total bonus earned. This helps understand time paid that does not result in a core function being accomplished. Remember, I don’t want the worker ID to appear more than once per week so make sure to calculate the function bonuses individually, but only present the added total of the bonuses for the employee in the week’s chart.

content.text: I am working on a schedule optimization project for our Production Department. We have produced JIT for orders in the past but we recently expanded our warehouse so we have storage capacity to better utilize our production lines and minimize the down-time for changeovers. Can you take the attached information and propose a production schedule for next week that minimizes total changeover times, while still having the inventory to fulfill the customer orders. Please provide a daily schedule for all four lines that includes the Product ID, Description, cases to produce, start time, end time and changeover time to the next product. The changeover activities are done simultaneously not consecutively. We cannot cut product from any outbound shipments so the order demand must be fulfilled on or before noon of the required by date. If this is not feasible, please say so, and provide the best feasible alternative. Please provide a brief summary (less than 500 words) at the end of the challenges you encountered and how you managed them so we can learn from the logic. One last thing, there needs to be two hours scheduled on each production line schedule on Wednesday for a mid-week deep clean for GMP, no production can run during this two hour window.
